payload.script: Smart farming uses sensors to monitor soil moisture and help farmers water crops only when needed. Weather forecasts and drone images can help identify crop stress. Technology supports farmers, but local knowledge and sustainable practices remain important.
Trust is earned slowly through consistent actions, honest communication, and keeping promises even when nobody is watching.
Cloud computing lets teams store data and run applications on remote servers instead of relying only on local computers.
